How to join a Game

  1. 1
    Open the bot

    Telegram or VK — whichever you prefer.

  2. 2
    Fill in the form

    Name, city, photo. This becomes your artist profile.

  3. 3
    Wait for the start

    The bot will send the first round's brief and remind you of deadlines.

Between Games

Challenges

Short briefs in the breaks between Games: one theme, one deadline. A good way to try a new technique or get back in shape before the next Game.

We announce the details of each challenge in the bot.

Season final

Super Final

Closes the season. Game medalists and the best artists of the season compete for the season cup and a prize fund.

Qualification rules are in the League Rules.

Past Games

Game 01 results — winners of League A and League B and the winners’ works — will appear here after the final on 10 November.

The bot will remind you when registration opens and send the dates as soon as we announce them.
